entry.title: Muse Dash v1.5.35
entry.content:
# Changes - Update songs to Song of Determination & Power - If the mod fails to get datastorage values on startup, it should continue on and give you free items (for now) rather than crash internally and put the mod in a bad state.
# Installation ## Melonloader *Melonloader is required to play with this mod. However reinstalling it is not required on update.*
> You can find Muse Dash's folder by finding the game in your steam library, right clicking it and choosing *Manage→Browse Local Files*.
### Windows 1. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.exe` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it. 2. Select Muse Dash in the list of games. - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`. 3. Click install. - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.7.2**
### Linux 1. Navigate to Muse Dash on steam, open properties and add the following to Launch Options: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%` 2. Download `MelonLoader.Installer.Linux` from https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/latest and run it. - You may need to give it permissions to execute. 3. Select Muse Dash in the list of games. - If Muse Dash does not appear, click add game manually then browse to `MuseDash.exe`. 4. Click install. On first run, melonloader may install dotnet 6 in order to run. - If the latest version is not working: **Untick Latest and select 0.7.2**
### Mod Install 1.Download `ArchipelagoMuseDash.zip`. 2. Head to the Muse Dash folder and open up `/mods/`. If this folder does not exist, run the game and it should appear. 3. Extract the contents of the .zip file into mods. Ensure the files are not in a subfolder, this mod is not setup for that yet. 4. Run the game. If a new button appears on the start screen the mod was installed correctly.

entry.title: Once Upon a Katamari v0.3.0
entry.content:
This updated mod is compatible with worlds generated using v0.1.0 and v0.2.x. The apworld is not compatible with older versions of the mod. ## Collectionsanity Collectionsanity allows you to turn (almost) every single unique roll in the game into a check. The 'BAN', 'DAI', 'NAM' and 'CO' objects, as well as all objects unique to the final "That Hole..." level are not currently included. A total of 3,637 objects are included. You can choose between 'individual' and 'milestones' mode. Individual means every unique object is considered a check. E.g. you get a check for specifically rolling up a tomato. Milestones means you gain checks for every x amount of unique objects rolled up. If you set it to 100, you'll get a check for rolling up 100 unique objects, and then 200 and so on. You can also set an amount of objects to be considered 'out of logic', so you don't have to hunt down every single object. Unless you want to. Objects found in the tutorial are not considered in logic as they are missable. You can set a percentage of collectionsanity checks on either mode to be forced to have a local junk item. ## Other Changes - You can now skip the tutorial - "As Large As Possible 1" is no longer a forced starting level. - Start with a random cousin - Fog Trap - Adds the fog from the 'Lots of Yokai' stage as a trap, which will slowly dissipate over time (does not activate on 'Lots of Yokai') - The preview shown before starting a level will now accurately show which crowns, cousins and presents you have collected in that level.
See the [README](https://github.com/ItsSeafoamy/Once-Upon-an-Archipelago/blob/main/README.md) for more info and setup instructions.
*it was mainly collectionsanity :3*

entry.title: Pokemon BW Extra Logic Plugin v1.8.0
entry.content:
**Fixes** * Fixed Tornadus/Thundurus/Landorus cutscenes crashing the game when there are too many dark areas * As a consequence, the roamer is now a static encounter until a better fix is made * Fixed the logic of the three locations near the entrance of Moor of Icirrus that can't be reached during winter without Surf
**Updates** * Added `randomize_starting_town` as an option * Swaps the player's house with a house from another town * Valid choices are: "Nuvema Town", "Accumula Town", "Striaton City", "Nacrene City", "Castelia City", "Nimbasa City", "Driftveil City", "Mistralton City", "Icirrus City", "Opelucid City", "Lacunosa Town", "Undella Town" * `starting_town_blacklist` prevents the listed towns to be chosen as the starting town if `randomize_starting_town` is activated * If Cynthia is set as goal, "Lacunosa Town" and "Undella Town" cannot be selected as the starting town * If all towns are blacklisted or if there is no valid choice, the option will fall back to Nuvema Town * When Mistralton City is chosen as the starting town, the Move reminder house is relocated in Nuvema Town and the logic for move evolution is updated accordingly * When the starting town is not Nuvema Town, Mom will not give her first item. An added clerk NPC in Nuvema Town will hand it instead * Adjusted multiple cutscenes to prevent sequence breaks with a random starting town
**YAML Options List** * The following options need to be added to the Black and White YAML under `plugin_options`: ``` plugin_options: extra_logic: # updated for v8 randomize_starting_town: true starting_town_blacklist: [] # list in README add_ss_ticket: true add_pass: true hm_with_badges: true add_rock_smash: true add_rock_smash_musharna: true # requires add_rock_smash extra_cut_trees: true extra_cut_trees_kyurem: true # requires extra_cut_trees move_strength_boulders: true move_strength_boulders_vi_road: true # requires move_strength_boulders dark_areas: ["Wellspring Cave B1F", "Mistralton Cave", "Challengers Cave"] # supports "_All" and "_Random", see README ```
**Important Notes** * The plugin needs to be installed by the host before generation. The player also needs the plugin to patch their ROM. * It is not possible to add the extra logic options mid-playthrough.
**Backwards Compatibility** * This version is compatible with v0.3.37+ of the main BW APworld * This version is compatible with v22 of the QoL Plugin
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Radis7Noir/pokemon_bw_extra_logic_plugin/compare/v7...v8

entry.title: Phoenotopia: Awakening v0.4.0
entry.content:
0.4.0 - Major QoL update

No new checks yet, but a lot of quality of life improvements that make playing this world a lot more streamlined. I'm not done with QoL features and felt tempted to keep going until it's perfect, but I feel like the ones in this update were essential. The rest can come later.

What's new:

- **Savewarping**: Open up the select menu and you'll see a new option "Warp to Savepoint". This lets you select a save point you have visited before and warp to it. No need to walk back all the way to the Anuri Temple once you have the required items. - **Dungeon item settings**: You can adjust settings for the placement of dungeon items, like Pearlstones and Ouro keys, in your YAML. Per dungeon you can say if you want to keep them vanilla, in their own dungeon, or shuffle them in the multiworld. - **Bundled dungeon items**: This option lets you bundle dungeon items into one item with infinite uses. The Anuri Pearlstone Necklace and Ouro Guard Kingring are custom items with custom sprites made by @ Damocles. Shoutout to them! - **Hinted shop items**: When you leave a shop without buying all the items, the remaining items are automatically hinted in the archipelago server. Free of charge, no hint points will be spent.

Fixes:

- When respawning in water after drowning or voiding out, Gail is set to the swimming state and will no longer infinitely drown. This way, Rocket Boots can be considered in logic for crossing bodies of water. - All key items now properly apply their showcase animation when picked up in your own world. Let me know if you want an option to disable these animations. - Picking up an item in your own world now gives you the item instantly and doesn't depend on the server to give you that item. This gets rid of the delay between picking up an item and getting it when playing on a remote server. - Moonstones now always get added to the inventory. Shoutout to @fight4day for finding this bug. - Some NPC checks no longer require you to have inventory space. - The turtle no longer uses up inventory space and can't be discarded. - The mouse in Ouroboros hideout that usually drops a key now properly swaps sprites when small animal checks are disabled. - Item popups now use the right font coloring. - Fixed a crash when entering the main menu without a server connection. Like always, the community will be my testing crew. If you encounter any issues during your run, please let me know through one of the following channels: 1. File an issue at the repository on [GitHub](https://github.com/Amphyros/Phoenotopia-Awakening-AP-client/issues). 2. Describe your issue in the game thread on the [official AP discord](https://discord.com/invite/8Z65BR2). 3. Post it in the mwgg-support channel in the [Unofficial AP Discord](https://discord.multiworld.gg).

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r2
entry.content:
> 🧪 **This is a beta.** Every change below was tested live in-game one at a time, but **no full start-to-finish run has been done on this build yet.** Expect rough edges, keep a backup save, and please report anything odd. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
This is the Discord feedback batch — seven reported bugs plus everything that turned up while testing the fixes. Biggest changes first. Huge thanks to everyone who reported, you made this release 💚
---
## 🏪 The statue blessing shop is a real Archipelago shop now — [#8](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/8)
Previously the statue was vanilla: vanilla names, vanilla prices, vanilla effects. Now the whole menu is hooked.
- Rows show **the AP item you'll actually get**, not the vanilla blessing name — `Tom's Progressive Armor - 2000` - Already-bought rows read `* Blue Necklace - [Done]`, matching the game's own style - Gear-upgrade rows ("Strengthen your armor") show their AP item too, so you can see when something important is sitting there - Prices are the randomized ones, deducted properly, and the vanilla effect is suppressed - F5 shop list is still there as a backup view while this settles
*Thanks to **CRIT MAGNET** for reporting that the shop's SP reduction did nothing and that spending SP paid the vanilla bonus on top of the check, and to **Shiro** (`cain1111`) for catching that progression balancing didn't reach vanilla SP <3*
## 🎁 Blessing effects can be items now (`blessing_items`)
New option. On: the statue sells **checks only** — buying reports the location and hands you whatever the seed put there. The blessing effects themselves become items that can show up in any check, anywhere in the multiworld.
## 📈 Three new progressive item types
- **Progressive blessing tiers** — the 7 levelled blessings arrive LV1 → LV2 → LV3, never out of order (`progressive_blessings`, on by default) - **Progressive elemental skills** — you get the Wind skill before Wind gems, per element. No more three emeralds and no skill (`progressive_skills`, on by default) - **Roo gear rewards folded into Progressive Armor / Boots** — the Sylphen Boots / Battle Armor line is part of the ladder instead of standalone drops
## 🗺️ +58 locations, −10
- **36 gear-upgrade checks** (12 per character) — every armor and boots tier can be strengthened once at a statue, and each is now its own check. This replaces the single old "Strengthen current armor" location, which was hardcoded to Hugo's starting armor and could never fire for Yunica or Toal. - **The Roo trades** — feeding the Roo was missing from the location set entirely ([#9](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/9)). Now checks, gated on how many Roda Fruits you hold. *Thanks to **Shiro** (`cain1111`) for spotting they were gone <3* - **6 late collectibles** that were never detected at all.
---
## 🐛 Bug fixes
- **Run-ending: the Red Moon Crest altar wouldn't activate** ([#3](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/3)). Key-item counts accumulated past 1, and the altar tests for *exactly* 1. Includes a repair pass that fixes an already-broken save. *Thanks to **Gravagar** for reporting <3* - **Checks you collected never sent** ([#4](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/4)). Two causes: scripts using `+=` and native pickups bypassed detection entirely, and anything collected while disconnected was lost forever. There's now a reconcile sweep over the save's own flags. *Thanks to **Shiro** (`cain1111`) for reporting <3* - **"Reach NF" checks couldn't fire in warp seeds** — they only triggered when walking up into a floor from below. Now standing on floor N *is* reaching it. - **Received items did nothing** ([#5](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/5)) — Gold Bracelet granted no double-jump. The vanilla chest sets two cells and only one was being written. *Thanks to **Shiro** (`cain1111`) for reporting <3* - **Vanilla items leaked through** alongside your AP item ([#6](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/6)) — you'd get the randomized item *and* the vanilla one. *Thanks to **CRIT MAGNET** for reporting <3* - **The Emerald chest handed out a free skill upgrade.** - **Shion attacked you as a boss** hours before he's supposed to, from a suppression writing into a story flag. - **Toal's Roo gave the Hammer** instead of the Ring of Ease. - **The opening movie couldn't be skipped** — Esc did nothing. The prologue file is language-prefixed and opens through a different system module than the one being watched.
## 🔧 Also
- **Cutscene / dialogue skip** ([#10](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/issues/10)) — `cutscene_skip` in `yso_ap.cfg`. *Requested by **CRIT MAGNET**, **Shiro** (`cain1111`), **Ultima Solus** and **HothRaka** <3* - **Per-item classification overrides** in your yaml — demote an item to `filler` when you know its gate is skippable - **Leaner progression in open mode** under `minimal` accessibility - **Blessing prices gated on reachable tower depth**, so no sphere-1 progression parked behind an 8000 SP wall - Empty-chest audit, offline reachability audit, and an Archipelago integration check in CI — all verified against the real 0.6.7 release, not a `main` checkout
---
## ⚠️ Known, not yet fixed
- **Yunica can softlock on 1F after the first Kishgal fight** — the scene that should trigger at the stairs doesn't, player control is never handed back, and the Crystal refuses with *"If I go anywhere, I'll just get in everyone's way."* Reported on 1.9.x by **Chiral**; **not confirmed fixed here.** The most likely cause is the key-item count inflation above, which this build both prevents and repairs — but that is a hypothesis, not a verified fix. If you hit it, please keep the save and the `yso_ap.log`. *Thanks to **Chiral** for the detailed report <3*
---
**Install:** drop `ys_origin.apworld` in `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. `Ys-Origin.yaml` is the option template.

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r2
entry.content:
> 🧪 **Still a beta.** Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**. This is beta 1 plus one fix — see [2.0.0-beta.1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full change list.
## 🔓 Fixes the post-Kishgal softlock on 1F
If you beat Kishgal, got dropped on 1F for the story scene, and then found that **the stairs event never triggers, you can't leave, and the Crystal answers with *"If I go anywhere, I'll just get in everyone's way"*** — this build repairs that, including on a save that is already stuck. Just update `dinput8.dll` and load your save; it fixes itself on the next tick and logs what it did.
**What was happening.** That 1F scene ends with a per-character block, and Yunica's never took effect:
``` test g_flags[150] == 1 <- Yunica jump-if-false past the block g_flags[278] += 4 g_flags[284] = 1 g_flags[286] = 1 g_flags[285] = 1 g_flags[287] = 1 g_flags[243] = 1 <- the one that matters ```
Everything before that block ran, and everything after it ran — only those six writes went missing, which is a state the game itself can't produce. `g_flags[243]` is what the north-exit trigger checks before starting the stairs event, and it's also why the Crystal refuses: the game still thinks the scene is in progress.
**Honest scope: this is a repair, not a cure.** We do not yet know *why* the branch gets skipped. The leading theory is that cutscene fast-forwarding lets the room transition tear the script down while its tail is still running, but that's unproven. So the mod detects the impossible state and replays exactly those six writes — nothing else. It can't misfire: `g_flags[346]` is set unguarded at the top of every story scene of that group, so "scene ran but branch didn't" is precisely `346 && !243`, and the check is further scoped to Yunica standing on 1F.
**Testing status:** the six writes were confirmed by hand on a live stuck save and unstuck it immediately. The automatic trigger compiles and is guarded, but hasn't yet been observed firing on its own — if you're the one who's stuck, you're the first real test. Please say whether it cleared, and grab `yso_ap.log` either way.
*Thanks to **Chiral** for the original report and the detail that made it findable, and to the second player who confirmed it's not a one-off <3*
## ⚠️ Still open
- **Devil's Corridor is under-gated in logic.** Passing it needs the Roo trade at `S_3104` (a Roda Fruit), not just the Crimson Lotusblade — as Yunica the Roo hums Feena's theme so the Silver Harmonica works; Hugo gets the Hammer, Toal the Ring of Ease. A seed that puts your first Roda Fruit past the corridor can strand you. Not fixed here: it needs a counted rule and a generation pass, not a quick data edit. - **26 location flags double as story-scene state** (`344`/`345` Red Moon Crest, `304` Cerulean Flabellum, `335` Levinstrike Warhammer, `385` Double Jump, `270`/`285` Dreaming Idol). These can fire checks you never earned. One consequence you may see: the 1F repair writes `285`, which will send `Wailing Blue: 1F Save — Dreaming Idol` as a side effect.
---
**Install:** drop `ys_origin.apworld` in `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. The apworld is unchanged from beta 1 — if you already have it, only the DLL needs replacing.

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r3
entry.content:
> 🧪 **Still a beta.** Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**. Two live-reported fixes on top of [beta 2](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.2); see [beta 1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full 2.0 change list.
## 🏪 The statue list no longer collapses to one item
Every row in the goddess-statue blessing list showed the **same** item, and buying that one row read as *[Done]* for all of them — locking you out of the rest of the blessings.
The row-to-location map was keyed by price, and it assigned every entry whose randomized cost matched a shop slot. So any blessings that happened to be **priced the same** all collapsed onto whichever slot came last. Vanilla-price collisions were already handled world-side; randomized-price collisions weren't — and they're common, since a narrow `blessing_cost_min`/`max` range (or the two being equal) makes every row identical. Each slot is now claimed at most once, so every row keeps its own location no matter how the prices land.
If you were hit by this, the fix applies as soon as you reconnect — nothing in your save is wrong, it was only ever a display/lookup problem.
## 🔌 A dropped connection no longer duplicates your consumables
Reconnecting handed out **another copy of every counted item** — and restored ones you'd already spent.
The server re-sends your whole item list on connect, and we replay it to rebuild state. That's idempotent for boolean key items (a set to 1), but not for the three counted cells — **Roda Fruit, Cleria Ore, Celcetan Panacea** — nor for the elemental skill levels, which *add* rather than set. So every reconnect topped them all up, including fruits you'd already fed to a Roo. Counted cells are now skipped on replay, the same rule the SP and trap branches already used: spendable state lives in your save and isn't safe to re-apply.
**If your counts are already inflated, this build won't shrink them** — it only stops further growth. Nothing is broken by having extra; feed the spares to a Roo or drink them.
*Both reported by **pokemonfan1937** <3*
## ⚠️ Reported and NOT fixed here
- **A check firing for the wrong location** — sending the Crimson Lotusblade check while receiving a Progressive Fire Skill from an unrelated chest. That location detects on a story flag, not on the artifact cell the skill grant writes, so the obvious mechanism isn't it and I don't want to guess. **If you hit this, please send `yso_ap_mod.log` from your `%TEMP%` folder** — the sweep logs a line every time it fires a location the normal path didn't, which should name the culprit.
## 🐞 Known, still open
- **Devil's Corridor and the 23F mirror are under-gated in logic.** Passing the corridor needs the Roo trade (a Roda Fruit), and the mirror into the Hall of Reflection needs the **Rod** — neither is modelled. The Rod one can in principle produce an unwinnable seed, since the Hall of Reflection leads to the endgame. Both need a generation pass, not a quick data edit. - **Suppressed vanilla state-changes still play their dialogue.** Killing the three Zelkarons announces "the Evil Ring is charged" when it wasn't — the real Evil Ring is a pool item, and receiving it is what opens the Rado's Annex door. The logic is correct; the message is a lie, and it sends you hunting a bug that isn't there. - **26 location flags double as story-scene state**, which can fire checks you never earned.
---
**Install:** drop `ys_origin.apworld` in `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. The apworld is unchanged since beta 1 — if you have it already, only the DLL needs replacing.

entry.title: Ys Origin v1.9.2r2
entry.content:
> 🧪 **Still a beta.** Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**. > > ⚠️ **Unlike beta 3, this one includes a new `ys_origin.apworld` — copy both files.** The generation fix below only exists in the apworld. > > **Already mid-run on a beta 3 seed?** Just take the DLL. It carries every mod-side fix *and* derives the Evil Ring fix locally, so it is correct against a beta 3 apworld too — you do not need to reroll your seed. The apworld matters for seeds you generate from now on.
See [beta 1](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.1) for the full 2.0 change list, and [beta 3](https://github.com/4rtefakt/ys-origin-archipelago/releases/tag/v2.0.0-beta.3) for the statue-list and reconnect-duplication fixes (both included here).
## 💍 The drained Evil Ring no longer clutters your inventory
The game stores the Evil Ring under **two** ids — one *"emits a power"*, one *"its power seems to have been drained"*. The Mask-of-Eyes chest gives you the drained one, and killing the three Zelkarons upgrades it in place to the charged one, which is what the Rado's Annex door checks.
Only the charged id was ever suppressed, so the chest still handed out the **drained** ring: an item that can never be charged (the upgrade targets the suppressed id) but looks exactly like the real thing in your inventory. Now you simply never see it — receiving the AP Evil Ring grants the charged one and the door opens, which is how it already worked.
This is applied from *both* sides, so an updated DLL fixes it even on an older seed.
## 🎲 Some option combinations couldn't generate at all
``` Fill.FillError: Not enough filler items for excluded locations. There are 16 more excluded locations than excludable items. ```
Provisional locations are marked filler-only, and Archipelago enforces that by requiring one filler item per such location. Certain option sets made the arithmetic impossible — turning statue/blessing/floor checks **off** while leaving room checks **on** removes the categories that supply filler but keeps all 166 scene-detected locations, and `weapon_requirements` / `random_start` promote further items to progression on top.
The filler-only marking is a precaution, not a correctness requirement, so generation now drops the *minimum* number of those markings instead of failing. Scene-detected locations go first — they do detect live; they're simply the ones confirmed most recently.
## 🔬 New: a seed fuzzer
`tools/fuzz_seeds.py` draws options independently and generates N seeds against a real Archipelago checkout. The hand-written test configs only ever covered combinations we thought of — which is exactly why the statue list collapsing shipped in two betas: every playtest used a wide shuffled price range, so a seed where blessings priced *identically* was never generated.
The fuzzer includes deliberately degenerate cases (a flat `500–500` band makes every blessing cost the same). It found the FillError above on its 16th seed. **40 randomized seeds now generate and pass Archipelago's own beatability check.**
## 🐞 Known, still open
- **Devil's Corridor and the 23F mirror are under-gated in logic.** Passing the corridor needs the Roo trade (a Roda Fruit); the mirror into the Hall of Reflection needs the **Rod**. Neither is modelled, and the Rod one could in principle produce an unwinnable seed. - **Suppressed vanilla state-changes still play their dialogue** — killing the three Zelkarons announces "the Evil Ring is charged" when it wasn't. The logic is correct; the message is a lie. - **26 location flags double as story-scene state**, which can fire checks you never earned. - **A check firing for the wrong location** (reported on beta 2, not reproduced). If you hit it, please send `yso_ap_mod.log` from `%TEMP%`.
---
**Install:** `ys_origin.apworld` into `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`.

entry.title: GemCraft: Frostborn Wrath v0.6.0
entry.content:
# GemCraft Frostborn Wrath — Archipelago Changelog
### 0.6.0
> ⚠️ **Breaking change.** Seeds generated with an older apworld are not compatible > with 0.6.0 — finish any in-progress async before updating, then generate new seeds > with the 0.6.0 apworld.
A large update: derived Wizard-Level progression gating, a full talisman rework (AP Shop + generated progression set), two new world-map information windows, and a long list of fixes. Covers both the Bezel mod and the apworld.
Legend: 🆕 **New** · ⬆️ **Improved** · 🗑️ **Removed** · 🐛 **Bugfix**
---
## 🆕 New
### Progression & logic - **Wizard Level (WL) gating.** Achievements and fields are now gated on a *derived* Wizard Level computed from collected XP, instead of the live in-game wizard level. Each achievement can override the effort-tier WL floor with its own `min_wl:N`. - **Difficulty-scaled battle XP.** The battle-XP multiplier's base now depends on difficulty — Easy 2.0 / Medium 1.5 / Hard 1.0 / Extreme 0.5 — recomputed live in battle and in the selector so the pre-battle and outcome displays reflect it. Trial mode is left untouched. (Extreme now requires Endurance enabled at generation.) - **`tm<Spell>Charge` achievement parity.** The mod resolves talisman Max-Charge achievement requirements by summing held progression fragments, mirroring the apworld, so their in-logic dots match generation.
### Talismans - **AP-generated progression talisman set.** Every seed gets a deterministic, bit-exact 25-fragment talisman (a legal 5×5 jigsaw with maxed starting/wave mana), giving the power model a fixed, known baseline. Freeze/Barrage charge sums are guaranteed high enough to keep their achievements reachable. - **Talisman AP Shop.** A hover-popup shop on the talisman screen to buy and place the 25 "perfect placement" fragments with shadow cores (net-zero vs. selling). - **Free talisman fragment on unlock.** Receiving an AP talisman unlock now drops one fragment straight into your inventory for free (once per unlock, deduped) — place, upgrade, or sell it as you like. The AP Shop stays for net-zero re-buys. - **"Archipelago item" tooltip marker.** AP-sourced talisman fragments now show an *Archipelago item* line in their hover tooltip (inventory / active slots), so you can always tell which fragments came from AP.
### World-map information windows - **Icon-based field tooltip.** The vanilla world-map field tooltip is replaced by an icon-driven panel: live stage data (name, waves, first-wave HP, real minimap), Journey/Stash check orbs colored by logic state (grey = done / green = in logic / red = blocked), granularity-aware pouch & stash-key item names, an "Available gems" row, and a list of the achievements you can earn by playing that field. - **Game Elements window.** A new selector window (button between "In Logic" and the AP Debug Menu) that inverts the field tooltip: toggle element / structure / creature / weather / gem icons to light up which fields carry them. Includes a 26×6 field grid with AND matching, ownership gray-out (fields you don't own can't tempt you), pouch-aware gem matching, and per-field hover contents.
### Stats & progress - **Always-visible achievement progress bars.** Cumulative "Reach N" achievements now draw a live progress bar (current total ÷ target) in the achievements window, so you can see how close you are without earning them first. Driven by a generated game_id → stat-index/target map.
### Update safety - **Breaking-update warning on the main menu.** When a newer version would invalidate a seed you're part-way through, the update badge turns **red** and reads "Update available — BREAKING", so you can tell at a glance whether it's safe to update mid-async. Any breaking release between your version and the latest trips it, not just the newest one. - **Changelog flags which version broke compatibility.** Each breaking release in the in-game changelog now carries a "finish any in-progress async before updating" banner.
### Options / QoL - **`extra_shadow_cores_per_wave` option (0–5).** Grants N extra shadow cores per wave reached, banked at level end like vanilla drops. Pure pass-through — no effect on items, locations, or logic.
---
## ⬆️ Improved
### Progression pacing - **Fixed the XP curve for a better early-game pace** — it now starts high and eases off toward the end.
### Skillpoint economy - **Reworked to fixed values.** Replaced the per-seed budget math with fixed SP items: 40 always-present bundles (32 Small + 6 Medium + 2 Big) plus a "Skillpoint" (1 SP) filler. Total SP now scales purely with a seed's check count — do more, get more. - Every achievement is **normalized to a flat 1 SP** while AP is active (vanilla 1/2/3 values snapshotted and restored on deactivate). - Fixed the bundle total (Medium 8 → 6; SP total corrected).
### Generation & pool - **Achievements are hard-gated at generation** on their full requirement DNF — elements with same-stage binding, gem/monster-stat counters, skills, traits, and field clearability — replacing the old loose "WL floor + skill/trait only" gate. A data-driven filler-only guard keeps the stricter counters from stranding progression items. - **Achievement requirement retuning.** A pass over per-achievement gates now leans on the derived Wizard Level instead of raw wave count where that models the real effort better — several shadow-core-find, talisman-fragment, and beam/barrage-count achievements swapped their `minWave` gate for a `min_wl` one, the strike-spell wave thresholds were raised, "Build 15 Towers" gained a light WL floor, and "Ground Luck" was reclassified Minor → Major. apworld and mod logic stay in lockstep.
### UI & tooltips - **Debug menu tabs** are now native game buttons with real hover/active-state frames. - **Field tooltip stays alive during the post-battle XP tally** (instead of dropping to the vanilla tooltip), and just-cleared checks are pushed the moment the game-over panel appears so it reflects the new in-logic state during the map tally. - **Field WL-blocker text simplified** to "Requires higher XP/WL" — the derived WL gate isn't the wizard level shown in-game, so showing a raw number was misleading.
### Docs - README / overview docs refreshed: skillpoint bundles, `xp_tome_bonus` default, `achievement_required_effort` default and per-level check counts, and the new `extra_shadow_cores_per_wave` option.
---
## 🗑️ Removed
### Progression & logic - **Fields no longer require other specific fields.** A field's only requirements are its own map token and enough progression — you'll never be told to go clear one particular field just to open another. (A couple of late fields still ask for the relevant skills, which was always the point of those.) - **Tiers are gone**, and requirement granularity was reduced across the board, for smoother gameplay and generation. - **Battle traits no longer inflate progression.** Traits still do everything they do in battle — they just no longer count toward the progression level that unlocks fields, so pacing is consistent no matter which traits you run.
### Item pool - **Retired the extra talisman fragments and extra shadow-core stashes** into filler; only the 25 progression fragments remain AP items.
### UI - **Removed the old Wizard Level slider** from the debug menu.
---
## 🐛 Bugfixes
### Achievements — corrected descriptions to match the real vanilla requirement The in-game text for these achievements did not match what the game code actually checks. The description shown in the achievements window is now corrected to the true requirement:
- **Crunchy Bites** — "Kill 160 frozen swarmlings" also requires the swarmlings to be in a **whiteout**; the text never said so. - **Absolute Zero** — "Kill 273 frozen monsters": frozen monsters that are *also* in a whiteout silently **don't count**. - **Snow Dust** — text says **95** frozen kills while snowing; the code requires **100**. - **Ablatio Retinae** — text says **111** whiteouts; the code unlocks at **90**. - **Green Path** — text says **9,900** green-blooded kills; the code unlocks at **9,000**. - **Green Vial** — text says **75%** of kills by poison; the code checks **> 74%**. - **Stirring Up the Nest** — "gem bomb and wasp kills only" also requires **at least 30 total kills**. - **Getting Rid of Them** — "Drop 48 gem bombs on beacons": gem bombs on **Jars of Wasps also count**. - **Deal Some Damage Too** — "Have 5 traps with bolt-enhanced gems" actually needs **6** (the check runs one enhancement before the new gem is counted).
### Achievements — fixed off-by-one that made "keep the orb intact" impossible These four could never be earned on a field with exactly the stated number of waves: the intact-wave counter starts at −1, so it tops out one short (e.g. 19 of the needed 20) and the game required N+1 waves. The mod now unlocks each at its stated wave count (the orb-XP bonus is left untouched), and the logic gates match:
- **Well Defended** — now unlocks at **20** intact waves (was 21). - **Tightly Secured** — now unlocks at **60** (was 61). - **It's a Trap** — now unlocks at **120** (was 121). - **You Shall Not Pass** — now unlocks at **240** (was 241).
### Achievements — other - **Achievement tooltip appended twice / onto the wrong tooltips.** The AP tooltip overlay is now gated to the active achievements window, so it no longer double-adds the "Archipelago" block mid-battle or bleeds onto non-achievement tooltips on other selector screens. - **WL gating didn't apply to achievements** — fixed.
### Standalone / state safety - **Standalone AP-state leaks fixed.** Several AP-mode mutations were only reversed on full unload, not on AP → standalone transitions: the message-log hotkey and resize listeners, per-battle patcher locks (GemPouch / HollowGem), and the difficulty-XP scaling. A standalone save loaded after an AP save is now pure vanilla.
### UI - **Menus silently stopped responding to clicks.** Panel / tab / scroll listeners were weakly referenced and got garbage-collected mid-session; switched to strong refs. - **In-battle info-panel tooltips were stripped every frame** by the talisman shop's cleanup; it now only removes the shared info panel when it owns the tooltip. - **Field tooltip lit up the wrong field** — the panel now blocks mouse events and force-highlights its own field. - **Field tooltip popped up behind on-map buttons.** The field hover hit-test ignored z-order, so an AP button drawn over a field token would still trigger the field tooltip (and append AP lines onto the button's own tooltip). Both field overlays now defer to any selector button under the cursor, matching the game's mouse routing. - **Field-token hit-testing leaked onto other selector screens.** On the achievements / skills / talisman / settings sub-screens (which sit over the map and reuse the shared info panel) the field overlay was still hit-testing the tokens behind them — hiding those screens' own tooltips and lighting a field behind the panel. It now fully releases the moment you leave the world map. - **Debug options window** bugs fixed. - Marked Monster icon no longer flagged as needs-fix.
### Logic - **Wizard Stash reachability** now requires the Wizard Stash Key item (parity with the apworld), except when `stash_key_granularity` is OFF.
### Misc - Additional smaller bug fixes and cleanup across the mod and apworld.
---
_Generated for the release following v0.0.5.6 — set the final version number in the header before publishing._
